title: Senior AI Engineer at Lemon.io
description_review: Senior AI Engineer placements via Lemon.io covering AI Engineer, AI Agent Architect and AI Automation Architect roles for startup clients. Requires 3+ years applying AI commercially, Python, vector databases and 2+ years each of LangChain and LLM/vLLM work. Strong applied AI and agent architecture fit, but the stack is Python-centric with no Java/Spring and no salary rate stated.
pros: AI Agent Architect and automation roles align with multi-agent platform experience
Senior commercial AI experience requirement matches applied AI background
cons: Python, LangChain and vector database stack with no Java/Spring Boot
Startup project placements with no banking, fintech or enterprise modernization

title: Senior .NET Full-stack Developer at Lemon.io
description_review: Senior .NET full-stack developer placements through Lemon.io across C#/.NET, .NET/React and Angular/.NET requests for startup clients. Requires 4+ years of commercial experience, 3+ years of .NET and React plus TypeScript. Seniority fits, but the role is .NET-centric, which is explicitly a weak fit for the Java/Spring profile.
pros: Angular and TypeScript appear in requests, matching part of the frontend stack
Senior scope with expectation of building projects from scratch
cons: .NET/C# centric stack, an explicitly weak fit versus Java/Spring Boot
No architecture, enterprise, banking or applied AI component

title: Senior Data Scientist at Lemon.io
description_review: Senior remote Data Scientist placements via Lemon.io requiring 4+ years of commercial experience, Python, Databricks and mandatory RAG/LLM experience, with an expectation of understanding application architecture. Startup clients with no stated salary rate. AI-related but primarily a data science role outside the Java/Spring engineering core.
pros: RAG and LLM requirements touch the applied AI area of the profile
Expects understanding of application architecture at a senior level
cons: Data science role built on Python/Databricks rather than Java/Spring engineering
No microservices backend, enterprise or banking domain described

title: Senior Independent AI Engineer / Architect at A.Team
description_review: Invite-only network role for senior independent AI Engineers and Architects building production AI systems, agent architectures and orchestration for startups and enterprises such as Lyft, Google X and Unilever. Remote across the Americas, Europe or Israel, with a $200M cumulative builder earnings figure (not salary). Directly matches the AI architecture, multi-agent orchestration and enterprise delivery strengths.
pros: Agent architectures and orchestration systems match the multi-agent platform built
Enterprise AI deployments align with enterprise software experience
Senior architect working directly with CTOs fits architecture-level scope
cons: No Java/Spring Boot stack mentioned; roles are AI-stack dependent
Independent contracting network rather than a permanent engineering role

title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer at Mitre Media
description_review: Tech Lead full-stack role at fintech firm Mitre Media architecting and implementing LLM-powered web applications on a microservices-based Rails 8 platform, reporting directly to the CTO. Serves investors and asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard, remote within ±3 hours of Eastern Time with no stated salary. Fintech domain, microservices architecture and LLM usage are strong matches despite the Ruby on Rails stack.
pros: Fintech domain serving major financial firms matches banking/fintech background
Microservices-based platform and tech lead architecting duties fit architecture strengths
LLM-powered product work aligns with applied AI experience
cons: Ruby on Rails full-stack instead of the Java/Spring Boot core stack
No salary information stated for the role
